scope: Three-scene local FP32 accuracy diagnostic, not mAP benchmark or Nano timing/power experiment. Two labelled source images contain five GT objects total; camera unlabelled. Five weather variants are dependent copies, not independent scenes.
runtime: CPU PyTorch FP32 restoration / ONNX Runtime FP32 detector
weather_order: Apply once at original source dimensions BEFORE branching or resizing. Identical degraded pixels shared by all paths. No added weather / fog / rain / snow / smoke, level 2 seed 43 time 0.
geometry: 128 and 256 aspect-preserving square canvases, bottom/right edge padding; return to source dimensions before identical 640x640 detector letterbox. Native retains original pixels and pads bottom/right to multiple of 8, then crops. No anisotropic stretch.
